notes.title: Keep Your Politics Bundle now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12510567/4e0df43a1a244143aaa90b97f8565cb8c156e7b4.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20653/

[h2]“Politics is not a game, but a serious business.” Winston Churchill.
[/h2]

We’re very excited to announce the launch of the Keep Your Politics bundle of six indie games. There’s a 10% discount for the entire bundle - and each game has a special sale price available (for a limited time) to compound your savings as we celebrate the launch of this awesome bundle of acclaimed titles.

It’s a Complete-The-Set bundle so you only pay for the games you don't yet own.

These games span a variety of gameplay genres and tell stories from different spaces and times - imagined and real. But all of them have important messages to share about the powers controlling politics and the people trying to survive its effects.

Take a look at the amazing games we have in the Keep Your Politics bundle:

[list]
[*] [h3]Orwell: Keeping an Eye On You
[*] Not Tonight   
[*] 1979 Revolution: Black Friday
[*] Headliner: NoviNews  
[*] Bury Me, My Love
[*] Orwell's Animal Farm[/h3]
[/list]

notes.title: Spanish, French, German, Farsi, Russian, & Turkish Localization Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello Steam Friends,

We are very excited to announce that subtitles and UI are all localized for 6 new languages:  [b]Spanish, French, German, Farsi, Russian & Turkish![/b]

We've been working very hard on this for the past few months - our primary goal with 1979 was to share it with as many different cultures as possible, and this is a BIG step forward in that commitment to make it a global community.

To change your language navigate to the "Options" menu on the Main Menu and select your language from the dropdown list.

To celebrate this big moment, we've made our [b]Game + Soundtrack edition 50% off for the next week[/b] - if you haven't picked up 1979 Revolution: Black Friday there's no better time than right now! 

If you have any bugs or localization errors, please let us know [url=steamcommunity.com/app/388320/discussions/4/]here at our new localization discussion forum[/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 4/27/2016 - Key Binding Added!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

We're excited to announce a new patch adding the ability to bind keys for the controls of 1979 Revolution: Black Friday!

[h1]Changelist:[/h1]

[list]
    [*]A controls menu was added (both in the main menu as well as the pause menu) allowing the player to remap keys for all the major controls in game.
    [*]Fixed a variety of minor gameplay bugs.
[/list]

[img]https://partner.steamgames.com/gfxproxy/gfx/apps/388320/extras/azerty_small.png?t=1461772583[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 4/19/2016
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

A patch is now live for 1979 Revolution: Black Friday that fixes and improves a bunch of various issues/bugs we've seen occurring.

[h1]Changelist:[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Unity project has been upgraded from Unity 5.2.2 to Unity 5.3.4! This should resolve issues on older graphics cards crashing at scene 1 due to post-processing effects. 
[*]Fixed issues relating to stories and photos being unlockable at the wrong sections of the game. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the player could take a photo in the Black Friday scene before they were intended to, which would make progression behave strangely. 
[*]Fixed an issue where gameplay would continue behind UI if the user entered the stories book from the photo review screen in certain situations. 
[*]Fixed multiple issues regarding users being unable to unlock progress achievements or track stat progress.
[*]Fixed multiple issues regarding blank or mis-firing subtitles. 
[*]Fixed an issue relating to two Steam accounts on the same computer preventing achievement unlocking. 
[*]All rapid tap prompts and the pressure mini-game for a specific character's trauma mini-game can now be performed using the Spacebar key. [b] Rapid Tap QTE can now be performed with the spacebar key.[/b]
[*]Adjusted certain UI elements to prevent buttons or menu items to disappear at 2k+ resolutions due to UI scaling. 
[*]Added UI to inspection camera buttons to better indicate when a object was interactive or not. 
[*]Fixed a variety of minor gameplay bugs.
[/list]
